title: Automamint
tagline: Automamint :: Simple automatic mint NFT All-in-all Solution.
description: Simple automatic mint NFT All-in-all Solution. All-in-one solution that conveniently mints NFTs, brings information, and tracks them. So user can their marketing for nft to the specific target. It used several protocol like covalent, NFTPort, IPFS, It's currently keep working on that.
how_its_made: IPFS: upload info as json to IPFS, NFTPort: https://docs.nftport.xyz/docs/nftport/b3A6MjE2NjM5MDM-easy-minting-w-url by using easy minting with url, user can minting nft includes ipfs hash. Covalent: https://www.covalenthq.com/docs/api/#/0/Class-A/Get-NFT-Token-IDs-for-contract/lng=en  get nft info which already minted. regarding frontend app, use next.js, chakra-ui. it's still continusly working now.
